name: Level Up
description: Six subjects, each a ladder of levels from pre-K to 8th grade: reading, math, color science, patterns, time and money, shapes and fractions.

about.concept: Mastery in small steps across six subjects. Each subject is a ladder of levels; a level is passed by getting a run of answers right, so the child always works at the edge of what they know.
about.progression: Each subject is a ladder of 15 to 20 rungs from pre-K to 8th grade: reading climbs from letter sounds through roots, figurative language and grammar to text structure; math from counting through fractions, decimals and equations to slope, exponents and the Pythagorean theorem; Color Lab from naming colors to the electromagnetic spectrum; Patterns from ABAB to sequences and if-then logic; Time and Money from telling hours to compound interest; Shapes and Fractions from naming shapes to circles, transformations and similar triangles. Four right in a row moves up a rung, and the child starts at the rung the tablet picks for her grade.
lifeSkills: Seeing progress as a series of steps
